'''Christian Martin Hennig''' (born 1966)<ref>{{cite web|url=https://d-nb.info/gnd/115717633|title=Christian Hennig|work=German National Library|access-date=2023-10-30}}</ref> is a German statistician. His work focuses on robust [[cluster analysis]].

== Education and career ==
Hennig completed his doctorate in 1997 at the University of Hamburg, Germany, under the supervision of Konrad Behnen.<ref>{{mathgenealogy|28672}}</ref>
From October 2001 until September 2003 he was University Lecturer (fixed term postdoctoral position) at the Seminar for Statistics, ETH Zürich.<ref>[https://math.ethz.ch/sfs/the-institute/people/former-staff.html Former staff of the Seminar for Statistics, ETH Zürich], retrieved 2023-10-25</ref>
Hennig was a lecturer at the Department of Statistical Science, [[University College London]] (UCL) from 2005 on, and became Senior Lecturer in 2010.<ref>[https://www.ucl.ac.uk/statistics/people/honorary-and-emeritus-staff Honorary and emeritus staff at the Institute of Statistics, UCL], retrieved 2023-10-25</ref>
Since 2019 he is full Professor at the ''Dipartimento di Scienze Statistiche "Paolo Fortunati"'' at the [[University of Bologna]].<ref>[https://stat.unibo.it/it/dipartimento/persone/docenti-e-ricercatori?pagenumber=4&pagesize=16&order=asc&sort=Cognome& Dipartimento di Scienze Statistiche Paolo Fortunati] Index of Lecturers and researchers, retrieved 2023-09-23</ref>

As of 2023, Hennig serves as the [[editor-in-chief]] of the journal ''[[Statistica (journal)|Statistica]]''.<ref>[https://rivista-statistica.unibo.it ''Statistica'', University of Bologna]. Retrieved 30 September 2023.</ref>

== Selected works ==
Hennig has published - partly with co-authors - about 130 papers in scientific journals and conference proceedings<ref>[https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Christian-Hennig Christian Hennig in Research Gate]. Retrieved 2023-10-30</ref> as well as - together with M. Meila, F. Murtagh, and R. Rocci - a Handbook of Cluster Analysis:
*Hennig, C., M. Meila, F. Murtagh, and R. Rocci (eds.) (2015). Handbook of Cluster Analysis. Chapman and Hall/CRC, New York 2015, ISBN 978-0-429-18547-2. https://doi.org/10.1201/b19706 
*Hennig, C. (2008). Dissolution point and isolation robustness: Robustness criteria for general cluster analysis methods. Journal of Multivariate Analysis 99, 1154–1176. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jmva.2007.07.002
*Hausdorf, B. and C. Hennig (2010). Species delimitation using dominant and codominant multilocus markers. Systematic Biology 59, 491–503. https://doi.org/10.1093/sysbio/syq039 
*Hennig, C. Mathematical Models and Reality: A Constructivist Perspective. Found Sci 15, 29–48 (2010). https://doi.org/10.1007/s10699-009-9167-x
